enrichment.headline: Awards $195,000 to Bay City Engineering to replace the boilers at Sankofa Academy
enrichment.summary: The district chose Bay City Engineering Company as the lowest responsive and responsible bidder to remove the old boiler and install two new cast-iron boilers at Sankofa Academy. Work is scheduled to start April 8, 2020 and last 90 calendar days, ending July 7, 2020. The contract went through competitive bidding.

enrichment.headline: Adds $12,771 to the inspector contract for the Emerson Elementary softball field, now $52,371
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds inspection work with Anthonio, Inc. on the Emerson Elementary School Softball Field Project. The state architect's office (Division of the State Architect) requires a higher class of inspector of record than the drawings showed. It adds $12,771, including a $6,831 contingency allowance, raising the cap from $39,600 to $52,371, and extends the term to December 3, 2020.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $24,800 more for TeachBar's teacher-exam test prep and tutoring, now $62,776
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $24,800 to the contract with TeachBar for test preparation and tutoring that helps teacher candidates pass California teacher certification exams. It raises the contract cap from $37,976 to $62,776 for August 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The board is approving it after the contract period began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Contract - TeachBar - Talent / Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Approves layoffs and additions of classified positions for the 2020-21 school year
enrichment.summary: This resolution reduces or lays off some classified (non-teaching) positions and adds or creates others for fiscal year 2020-2021, based on lack of funds or program need. It follows an earlier resolution from March 4, 2020 and the 2020-2021 budget development process. The text gives no dollar amounts or position counts.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Layoffs/Additions/Net of Classified Positions for Fiscal Year 2020-2021

enrichment.headline: Extends the state refugee student grant to June 2021; no new money is added
enrichment.summary: This amendment to a California Department of Social Services grant extends the time to use the money from June 20, 2020 to June 13, 2021. The district uses the unspent part of the $1,835,520 grant to serve newcomer refugee and unaccompanied minor students. The text states no added dollars.

items.fundingSource: California Department of Social Services, Refugee Programs Bureau Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment, Grant Award - California Department of Social Services - Refugee Programs Bureau - English Language Learner & Multilingual Achievement (ELLMA) Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $58,800 for Legacy Leaders to supply an interim principal at Sankofa Academy
enrichment.summary: The district contracted with Legacy Leaders, LLC to supply an interim principal at Sankofa Academy for December 2, 2019 through May 29, 2020, for no more than $58,800. The service began before the board's approval, which is a ratification.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Legacy Leaders, LLC - Elementary Network 2

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $2,250 for Blue Thistle Consulting to document the Kindergarten Readiness Program
enrichment.summary: Blue Thistle Consulting will write a workflow and transition timeline document for the Kindergarten Readiness Program, covering its responsibilities, structure, timeline and partnerships, because the program manager is leaving. The contract runs February 18 through June 30, 2020, for no more than $2,250. It began before the board's approval.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Blue Thistle Consulting - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $6,500 for Mills Teacher Scholars to run a planning retreat for Expanded Learning staff
enrichment.summary: Mills Teacher Scholars facilitated a two-day strategic planning retreat for the district's Expanded Learning staff on February 10 and 11 at Mills College. It also helped set the agenda beforehand and reflected with the team afterward, for no more than $6,500. The work began before the board's approval.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Mills Teacher Scholars - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Leases part of the Lakeview site to American Indian Public High School for about $151,100
enrichment.summary: The district lets American Indian Public High School, a charter school, use part of the Lakeview School Site at 746 Grand Ave. to run grades 9-12 from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021. This is an in-lieu of Proposition 39 agreement, and the school pays the district an anticipated use fee of $151,099.72.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: In-Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement - American Indian Public High School - School Year 2020-2021
